caption: Introducers & Partners
vo: Brokers, agents and professionals refer clients for a commission. Let's follow one from onboarding, all the way to the commission they earn.

caption: Anil Bhugaloo, a notary in Port Louis, wants to refer clients to Genesis
vo: Anil Bhugaloo, a notary in Port Louis, wants to refer clients to Genesis. Like every introducer, Anil is first a party, the record KYC runs on.

caption: Sign in as Shalini Ramtohul — Head of BD & Strategic Partnerships
vo: We're Shalini Ramtohul, Head of BD and Strategic Partnerships. She onboards and manages introducers.

caption: Clients ▸ Parties ▸ New: identity and contact details
vo: First, Shalini creates Anil's party record. Open Clients, then Parties, click New, and fill in the identity and contact details.

caption: Growth ▸ Introducers ▸ Introducer onboarding
vo: Then the introducer onboarding wizard. Two steps, who the introducer is, then the agreement and commission plan.

caption: The portal email is how the introducer will sign in to the introducer portal
vo: The portal email is how Anil will sign in to the portal.

caption: Agreement & commission: the agreement is not signed yet
vo: The agreement isn't signed yet. Shalini picks the products Anil may refer, and clawback and the protection window keep their defaults.

caption: Introducer created at Applied — complete KYC to activate
vo: Anil's created at Applied, with an introducer number. Before activation, KYC has to be completed.

caption: Onboarding pipeline: Applied ▸ KYC ▸ Agreement ▸ Active
vo: The onboarding runs Applied, KYC, Agreement, Active. Anil moves to KYC while the documents are collected.

caption: Now try Agreement…
vo: Now let's try Agreement. It needs the signature date and the commission rate.

caption: The agreement is signed: record the date, expiry and commission rate
vo: Once the agreement's signed, Shalini records the date, the expiry, and the rate, zero point four percent of the funded or disbursed volume.

caption: Move to Agreement again — this time it goes through
vo: Move to Agreement again, and this time it goes through.

caption: Activate the introducer…
vo: Now can she activate Anil? Not until the CRM has checked the introducer's own KYC.

caption: Blocked: KYC is not approved yet
vo: Blocked. KYC isn't approved yet. The proper route is a KYC case on Anil, signed off by Compliance.

caption: KYC & Compliance ▸ KYC Cases ▸ New
vo: So she opens a new KYC case. It's group-level KYC, the very same process as for a client, covered in tutorial eighteen.

caption: ID, proof of address and source of funds are on file
vo: Anil's ID, proof of address and source of funds are on file. She ticks the checks and sets the FATCA status.

caption: Move it to Screening: sanctions and PEP lists are checked automatically
vo: Move it to Screening, and the sanctions and PEP lists are checked automatically.

caption: Screening is clear — Pending approval sends the case to Compliance
vo: Screening's clear. Pending approval sends the case to Compliance.

caption: Sign in as Fatima Hossenbux — Compliance Officer
vo: Fatima Hossenbux, the compliance officer, signs off the KYC. It's four eyes. The Head of BD can't approve her own introducer, so the decision is Compliance's.

caption: Back to the Head of BD: activate the introducer
vo: Back to Shalini. KYC approved, agreement signed, so this time the gate lets Anil through.

caption: Sign in as Shalini Ramtohul — Head of BD & Strategic Partnerships
vo: She signs back in to activate Anil. Both conditions are met, so there's nothing left in the way.

caption: Anil Bhugaloo is active: KYC approved, agreement and commission on file
vo: Anil Bhugaloo is active, with KYC approved and the agreement and commission on file. Only active introducers can sign in to the portal.

caption: Meanwhile, Hemraj Ah-Kye — an active broker — has a client to refer
vo: Meanwhile, Hemraj Ah-Kye, an active broker, has a client to refer. He uses the Genesis Capital introducer portal.

caption: Choose Introducer and enter the portal email Genesis holds
vo: He chooses Introducer and enters the email Genesis holds. No password, just a one-time code by email.

caption: Outside production the code is shown on screen
vo: Outside production the code shows on screen. In production it comes by email and expires after ten minutes.

caption: His referrals and commissions — only his own
vo: He sees his own referrals and commissions, nobody else's. Status shows only where the prospect agreed to it.

caption: Refer a client: Mélanie Rault needs a personal loan
vo: Now he refers a client. Mélanie Rault needs a personal loan, so he fills in her details.

caption: She agreed that Hemraj may follow her application
vo: She's agreed that Hemraj can follow her application, so he'll see its status.

caption: The referral is in — Submitted
vo: Submitted. It lands in the CRM at once.

caption: Back in the CRM, the Head of BD sees the referral
vo: And back in the CRM, Shalini already sees the referral.

caption: The CRM created an enquiry for the prospect, credited to the introducer
vo: The CRM has created an enquiry for the prospect, credited to the introducer. That attribution is protected for ninety days from submission.

caption: The enquiry: channel Introducer, linked to Hemraj
vo: The enquiry's channel is Introducer, linked to Hemraj, so he gets the credit for the whole window.

caption: Routed by product like any other enquiry: Retail Loans, to Yash Bholah
vo: It's routed by product like any other enquiry, to Yash Bholah in Retail Loans, and the speed-to-lead clock starts now.

caption: As the desk works the enquiry, BD moves the referral along
vo: As the desk works the enquiry, BD moves the referral along. Submitted, accepted, in progress, then funded or disbursed.

caption: The loan is disbursed — try Funded / disbursed…
vo: The loan's disbursed. But try to mark it funded, and the CRM asks for the funded amount, because that's what the commission is worked out on.

caption: Record the amount actually disbursed: MUR 1,400,000
vo: So Shalini records the amount actually disbursed, one point four million rupees.

caption: Funded: the commission is accrued automatically
vo: Funded, and the commission accrues automatically. Hemraj's rate is zero point five percent, on one point four million rupees. That's seven thousand rupees.

caption: Status Accrued — Finance approves and pays it, then marks it Paid
vo: It's Accrued. Finance approves and pays it, then marks it Paid, and Hemraj sees it under Commissions in his portal.

caption: A client repaid a referred personal loan early, within the 12-month clawback period
vo: Now, a client repaid a referred loan early, inside the twelve-month clawback period. So Hemraj's June commission is clawed back.

caption: Clawed-back commission no longer counts as earned
vo: Clawed-back commission no longer counts as earned, and his total is recalculated.

caption: Dashboard ▸ Marketing: the introducer channel at a glance
vo: On the Marketing dashboard, you see the introducer channel at a glance.

caption: Referrals by stage — from submitted to funded
vo: Referrals by stage, from submitted to funded. And commission by status, accrued, approved, paid, and clawed back.

caption: Introducers & Partners
vo: So that's introducers and partners. They're onboarded with the same rigour as clients, and every referral traces back to the commission it earns. Next, Revenue.
